about_the_game:
The Last Route Together is an episodic psychological horror game in which each episode tells a short story revealed by a survivor.

This is the first episode of Series:

The Last Route Together - Ashwood Trip

In the first episode of The Last Route Together, you play as Sam, preparing for a trip you promised your friend. Alone at home on New Year’s Eve, you and Brian, aspiring filmmakers, plan to make a short horror movie. The trip quickly turns deadly as strange events unfold, and your stop at a quiet gas station to buy supplies becomes your last chance to feel safe before the nightmare.

The Gameplay

This game is a first-person narrative walking simulator with driving, exploration, and interactive conversations, featuring dynamic environments and immersive gameplay elements.

Key Features

  • VHS film aesthetics.

  • Eerie atmosphere and photo-realistic graphics.

  • Interact with NPCs and receive texts.

  • Player voice activity.

short_description: You play as Sam, 21 years old, on New Year’s Eve, you are preparing for a trip you promised your friend the day before. You are alone at home that night, getting ready for the trip, which soon turns deadly as strange events begin to unfold.
supported_languages: English, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
